description: This file defines functions and types for creating and managing test environments within Mattermost, including creating test teams, users, channels, and posts for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestEnvironment
classes.description: Represents a test environment containing multiple teams and their respective environments.

classes.name: TeamEnvironment
classes.description: Represents the environment for a specific team, including its users and channels.

methods.name: CreateTestEnvironmentWithTeams
methods.description: Creates a test environment with multiple teams, each with users, channels, and posts.

methods.name: CreateTestEnvironmentInTeam
methods.description: Creates a test environment within a specific team, including users, channels, and posts.
